O.name: 原始 Chimera
O.provenance_rule: Current legacy toggle, old repair failures, and original-description replay do not establish original Chimera provenance.

detectors.replacement_policy: Lightweight detectors may debug only; cannot silently replace a missing main method.

seed_aggregation_policy.main_result: arithmetic mean of per-seed metrics and paired N-minus-O differences; no seed selection or score ensemble
seed_aggregation_policy.internal_domain_macro: per-seed domain metrics weighted 0.5/0.5, then mean across seeds
seed_aggregation_policy.preserve: all per-seed metrics, predictions, validation thresholds, SD and range
seed_aggregation_policy.main_ci: conditional on fixed trained seed models; same target group/episode bootstrap indices for both sources and every seed, recompute metrics then mean; no seed resampling
seed_aggregation_policy.training_generation_uncertainty: separate outer training-group resampling and refit, additional compute
seed_aggregation_policy.deterministic_reuse: verify identical fits, register duplicate mapping; no independent sample claim
seed_aggregation_policy.failed_seed: report and rerun; incomplete results cannot become complete main row

validation.description: Freeze a shared validation pool from O/N source validation groups; both training sources receive the same tuning/threshold information. No external test/labels used. A source-only validation transfer experiment must be separate.

target.within_domain_prevalence: retain native prevalence, never balance to improve metrics

stage2_primary.full_oracle_comparison: only if both sources have the same task specification and verifiable artifacts

serious_defect_definition.estimand: eligible packages with at least one independently confirmed serious defect / all eligible packages
serious_defect_definition.deduplication: same package, event and defect type; repeated annotations count once
serious_defect_definition.expert_confirmation: at least 2 of 3 independent experts confirm the same evidenced defect; at least 2 judge package eligible; remaining disputes require blind adjudication
serious_defect_definition.unresolved_or_missing_evidence: abstain/UNKNOWN; report coverage and per-source reasons, not defect-free
serious_defect_definition.separate_burden_metric: confirmed distinct defects per 100 eligible packages

result_policy: No numerical scores, differences, intervals or PASS without actual evidence; retain missing capabilities and source acquisition limits.
